candidates.label: 神の一手
candidates.headline:
AIの一打は
「神の一手」なのか？
candidates.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: a Japanese note article cover thumbnail, wide horizontal landscape, approximately 1.91:1 aspect ratio, target 1920x1008. Produce ONE complete polished raster cover, not a collage. Audience: mahjong readers who may feel intimidated by dense articles. Article is about learning thoughtfully from AI recommendations, supervised learning and reinforcement learning, performance records and interpretation, and the gap between AI choices and human explanations. The tone questions blind trust without attacking any specific AI.
Design for small-screen legibility: extremely large beautiful accurate Japanese Gothic headline, concise hierarchy, strong contrast, generous 10% outer margins; keep all important text in the central 70% height for cover crops. Render only the specified text, no extra words or candidate numbers.
Constraints: absolutely NO mahjong tiles, tile faces, tile-like rectangles, playing cards, real mahjong hands, people, robot faces, manga characters, NAGA/LuckyJ/company logos, software screenshots, watermarks, fabricated numerical statistics, mockup frames. Mahjong atmosphere may be conveyed by dark table-green, subtle abstract river-like grid patterns, and mathematical or neural-path motifs, all decorative and without numbers.
Style: sophisticated bold editorial cover, deep green and near-black matte background, white typography with 「神の一手」 highlighted warm gold. Large headline across the left two thirds. On the right, one large elegant typographic question mark created from a sparse network of fine gold paths and points, symbolizing an unresolved best move. Restrained abstract grid near the bottom. Powerful, focused, curious, high visual impact, no glitter clutter.
Exact main text, two lines:
AIの一打は
「神の一手」なのか？
Exact small series line:
麻雀AIを信じる前に｜後編
